author: __Sensus
body:
Hello, my name is __Sensus in minecraft.

I have been banned as of August of 2014 which is a long time ago. I was banned for advertising other servers and I don't recall the specific server I was advertising.

I wish to be unbanned from avic.us and wish to play on this server again. I recently started playing minecraft again and I find this really fun and enjoyable to play on. I am no way shape or form saying that my ban was not deserved because it probably was and I personally think I have matured over the year from when I played minecraft previously. I wish for this to be reviewed and hopefully the ban can be lifted from my account. Sorry for not knowing much about the account, and I am again, not saying in any way that I didn't deserve this ban because honestly if I could meet my younger self when I played minecraft a lot then I'd probably smack him because he used to be very annoying and obnoxious. 

Thank you staff of Avicus!

-__Sensus
